<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
silu(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.reference`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

SiLU / swish: `x * sigmoid(x)`, evaluated in a numerically stable form.

`sigmoid(x)` is computed from `exp(-|x|)` so large negative inputs do not
overflow `exp` (the result underflows to `0.0` instead, which is what
`torch.nn.functional.silu` produces).

## Parameters

- `x` · `np.ndarray` — Real array of any shape.

## Returns

- `np.ndarray` — `float32` array with `x.shape`.  `float64` input is downcast.
